_rules: One or two short sentences: what happened, then what is safe or what to do next.
Sentence case everywhere. No exclamation marks, no oops, no we.
Buttons start with a verb. Confirm buttons repeat the action, red when it deletes.
Same fact, same sentence, in every place it appears.
Words: usage, credits, reset, payment. Times: Monday at 8:00 AM. Reset price: $5. Balances show cents.
Placeholders in braces fill in at run time: {amount}, {balance}, {deck}, {n}, {file}.

_patterns.toast.error: Unable to {verb}. {What is safe}. Action: Try again.
_patterns.result.error: Title: Unable to {verb}. Body: {What is safe}. Try again. Buttons: Close, Try again.
_patterns.notice.card: Title: {What happened}. Body: {When it changes} or {what is safe}. One or two actions.
_patterns.error.page: Title: Unable to {verb} or {Thing} has expired. Body: {Why}. {Fix}. One button.
_patterns.empty.state: Title: No {things} yet. Body: {What this place is for}. Button: {Create thing}.
_patterns.banner.waiting: Waiting for {thing}. {Where to finish}. Actions: Open, Cancel.
